_comment: Field example for Livox Mid-360 via livox_ros_driver2.
Copy to livox_mid360_field.json and verify every FIELD value on site.
Unlike the Hesai driver this config is JSON, not YAML.
Mid-360 IP is 192.168.1.1XX where XX is the last two digits of the serial
number printed on the sensor, so the ip below MUST be replaced before first
this file uses 192.168.1.100 / host 192.168.1.50 so a stale value is
obvious rather than silently matching someone else's rig.
Sensor readout only. Do not enable robot motion from this stage.

host_net_info._comment: FIELD: host_ip must be this machine's static IP on the LiDAR subnet.

lidar_configs._comment: FIELD: replace ip with 192.168.1.1XX from the sensor serial number.
